{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify the 6 QA rows with revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

# Drop these rows from the dataset
data_clean = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Verify the drop
print(f"New dataset shape: {data_clean.shape}")

# Check the conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = data_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rates by channel:\n", conversion_by_channel)

# Compute the difference: email - paid_search
email_rate = conversion_by_channel['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_by_channel['paid_search']
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

print(f"Email conversion rate: {email_rate}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_rate}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference}")"}
